audit.why: 47.11% over 2095 games is a losing lane and the page already reads it that way — level 1 contested, everything after that Singed's.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 and late spikes never mention Insanity Potion's Grievous Wounds, which is the single thing that changes how those phases play.
audit.why: Insanity Potion makes Poison Trail apply healing reduction. Glory in Death heals Sion off his rapid attacks, so the zombie window — the entire reason Sion survives a losing lane — is cut in half the moment his R is up. It runs on a flat 100-second cooldown, which is a real window to fight inside.
audit.corrected: Written into whys[4] and late with the 100-second figure.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[2] and mid both say Mega Adhesive roots you and then Fling repositions you. That is backwards and overstates the W.
audit.why: Riot's text: Mega Adhesive slows and grounds enemies who walk on it. The root is on Fling — 'if the target Singed flings lands in his Mega Adhesive, they are also rooted'. The goo goes down first and the Fling is what converts it into a root.
audit.corrected: Reordered in whys[2], mid and wants.foe[1], with Fling's 10s rank-1 cooldown so the player has something to count.

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet flags zero cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere in this matchup, and it was right — not one number appeared.

edits.before: From level 2 onward Singed's Q poison trail goes live and the lane tips decisively his way. He will use W Mega Adhesive to root you in place so your charged Q cannot be repositioned, then Fling you backward into his poison so you take the full tick damage retreating. Your W-shield helps on the Fling burst but it does not cancel poison duration — you are eating damage every time you move through his trail on the way back to tower. At level 6 your R can theoretically catch a proxying Singed but he will Fling you the moment you connect and your HP drops while his regen restores. Play conservatively, track his proxy timings, and do not chase more than two steps past the minion wave.
edits.after: From level 2 onward Singed's poison trail goes live and the lane tips decisively his way. Mega Adhesive by itself only slows and grounds; the root arrives when Fling drops you into the goo, so the sequence to watch is adhesive down, then Fling on a 10-second cooldown at rank 1. Your W-shield covers the Fling burst but does not cancel poison duration — you eat damage every step you take back through his trail. At level 6 your R can catch a proxying Singed, but he Flings you the moment you connect while his regen restores. Play conservatively, track his proxy timings, and never chase more than two steps past the wave.

edits.before: Late game Singed has Rylai's and Chemtank online and his Q trail slows everything in it — your R charge is one of the few tools that ignores his run-down setup, but even a successful R engagement gets Flung into a bad angle. Your zombie passive (Glory in Death) does give Singed real incentive not to walk into melee with you freely, so use that threat to zone him off objectives. In teamfights you are the engage tool and he is the chaos agent — do not try to duel him, because his poison out-ticks your W-shield regeneration over any extended fight. Land your R onto their carries and let your team clean up while Singed runs a separate flank.
edits.after: Late game Singed's trail slows everything in it — your R charge is one of the few tools that ignores his run-down setup, but even a clean engage gets Flung into a bad angle. Insanity Potion is the deeper problem: it makes Poison Trail apply Grievous Wounds, so Glory in Death heals for half in the one window you rely on. It runs on a flat 100 seconds, so the fights worth taking are the ones where you saw him drink already. In teamfights you are the engage and he is the chaos agent — land R onto their carries and let your team clean up while Singed flanks.

notes: Two item claims I left alone because I cannot verify them against 26.15 from the kits: whys[5] and spikes[2].text both build Singed around 'Rylai + Chemtank', and Turbo Chemtank's current status is an item question, not a kit question. Recorded in unverified. Also left unasserted: whether Mega Adhesive's grounding stops Unstoppable Onslaught. The flag says grounding shuts off dashes and Sion's R is a charge rather than a dash — the kits do not resolve which side of that line it falls on, and guessing would either scare a player off his only engage or send him into a wall.
